mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.ticket_no, t.order_id, t.schedule_id, t.seat_no, t.passenger_name, t.id_card, t.phone, t.price, t.status, t.check_time, t.checker_id, r.route_name, r.depart_port, r.arrive_port, sh.ship_name, s.depart_time, u.name AS checker_name FROM ticket t JOIN schedule s ON t.schedule_id = s.id JOIN route r ON s.route_id = r.id JOIN ship sh ON s.ship_id = sh.id LEFT JOIN user u ON t.checker_id = u.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket (ticket_no, order_id, schedule_id, seat_no, passenger_name, id_card, phone, price, status) VALUES (#{ticketNo}, #{orderId}, #{scheduleId}, #{seatNo}, #{passengerName}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{price}, #{status})

INSERT INTO ticket (ticket_no, order_id, schedule_id, seat_no, passenger_name, id_card, phone, price, status) VALUES
(#{t.ticketNo}, #{t.orderId}, #{t.scheduleId}, #{t.seatNo}, #{t.passengerName}, #{t.idCard}, #{t.phone}, #{t.price}, #{t.status})
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE ticket SET status = #{to} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
UPDATE ticket SET status = 'CHECKED', check_time = #{checkTime}, checker_id = #{checkerId} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PAID'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ticket WHERE schedule_id = #{scheduleId} AND id_card = #{idCard} AND status IN ('UNPAID','PAID','CHECKED')
